name: Wit of the Waterfall’s End
body:
School illusion; Level: jester 9

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Personal
Target: You
Duration: 1 round

DESCRIPTION

Until the end of combat, when you move through an ally’s space, that space does not count toward your movement limit.
